evidence_states.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED: Substantive executor source exists at the recorded commit; dependencies and live providers are not implied.
evidence_states.ADAPTER_CONTRACT_PROMOTED: A portable, bounded canonical adapter contract and skill have been added.
evidence_states.RUNTIME_RESPONDED: A named runtime endpoint answered during this work.
evidence_states.EXECUTED_UNVERIFIED: A provider returned an artifact/result that still requires independent acceptance.
evidence_states.VERIFIED: Independent postconditions and artifact evidence passed.
evidence_states.PLACEHOLDER_OR_SIMULATION: The source returns mock, placeholder, deterministic shell, work-order-only, or self-issued success.
evidence_states.BLOCKED: The dependency or authority required for execution was absent or failed.
evidence_states.FAILED: The attempted current execution did not complete or satisfy its gate.
